target: number of normalized judicial records per county and calendar month
target_semantics: observed record count, not a population-adjusted crime rate
geography: county-level administrative units in mainland China

released_sample.selection: ten counties with the longest histories in the 40-county panel

source.name: China Judgments Online (中国裁判文书网)

redistribution: only county-month aggregates and derived features; no judgment text, case numbers or personal names
task_b: next-month offense-type distribution; excluded from this package because only five forward-test rows meet its eligibility rule
known_limitations: counts depend on publishing and case-selection practice
incident months are recovered from judgment text and are less complete than judgment dates
missing months are treated as zero observed records after county eligibility
